description: Primary-source statutory environmental clearances, Form V environmental audit statements, and ESG water disclosures for data centre facilities in Maharashtra.
epistemic_guards: Navi Mumbai regulatory observations apply strictly to verified Navi Mumbai sites and must NEVER be attached to STT Pune 5 or STT Mumbai 2.
Portfolio-wide ESG metrics are aggregate figures and must NEVER be presented as measured facility WUE.
Approved/consented quantities reflect statutory regulatory caps, not measured daily draw.
Actual quantities reflect audited utility meters or Form V statements.

observations.reporting_facility: STT Navi Mumbai Data Centre Campus
observations.operator: STT Global Data Centres India Private Limited
observations.locality: TTC Industrial Area, MIDC, Navi Mumbai
observations.regulatory_authority: State Environment Impact Assessment Authority (SEIAA), Maharashtra
observations.water_source: MIDC Piped Industrial Water Supply (Barvi / Morbe catchment)
observations.cooling_configuration: High-efficiency chilled water cooling plant with closed-loop piping; treated wastewater recycled for HVAC make-up
observations.wastewater_management: On-site Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) with 100% recycling for toilet flushing, landscaping, and HVAC make-up; zero unauthorized discharge to storm drains
observations.source_document: SEIAA Maharashtra Environmental Clearance Order EC24B038MH162952
observations.page_or_reference: Specific Conditions - Water Environment & STP, Condition II.(a)
observations.cross_site_prohibition: Applies strictly to STT Navi Mumbai campus. Prohibited from cross-site attachment to STT Pune 5 or STT Mumbai 2.
